idea-plugin.name: JCEF + Playwright E2E Example
idea-plugin.description: Minimal example demonstrating the JCEF + Playwright end-to-end testing pattern, in both the monolith IDE and V2 split (remote development) mode. A frontend-module tool window hosts a JCEF page with a button; clicking it round-trips through the browser pipe to Kotlin and back to display a message. The e2e tests drive it two ways: at the browser-pipe boundary and with real Playwright gestures over the Chromium DevTools Protocol.
